# CodeClovers // High-Performance Web Development Agency

> CodeClovers is an elite full-stack web engineering studio specializing in Next.js 14 App Router applications, high-concurrency Node.js microservices, Neo-Brutalist design systems, and guaranteed 100/100 Core Web Vitals audits.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Full-Stack Next.js 14 Web Applications**: React Server Components (RSC), Edge Runtime, Upstash Redis caching, Prisma ORM, and sub-300ms global TTFB.
- **Neo-Brutalist Design Systems**: High-contrast Swiss Grid typography, WCAG AAA compliant 21:1 color contrast, tactile 2px ink borders, and Figma token pipelines.
- **Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals**: Automated dynamic Schema.org JSON-LD graphs, automated edge XML sitemaps, zero hydration layout shift (CLS 0.000).
- **Rapid SaaS MVP Sprints**: 2-to-4 week production cycles with 100% full intellectual property and clean GitHub repository transfer.

## Fixed-Scope Sprint Pricing Tiers
- **Starter MVP**: $1,999 (2-week turnaround, 1-3 custom pages, 100/100 Lighthouse guarantee, 14-day warranty).
- **Growth Studio**: $4,499 (3-week turnaround, full-stack database & auth, dynamic CMS & Stripe integration, 30-day warranty).
- **Enterprise Scale**: $8,999+ (4-6 week sprint, high-concurrency architecture, multi-tenant RBAC, custom SLA).
- **Retained SLA**: $3,499/month (Dedicated ongoing engineering allocation, 4-hour SLA response, continuous feature deployments).

## Key Production Benchmarks
- Global Time-To-First-Byte (TTFB): 140ms
- Google Lighthouse Scores: 100/100 across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO
- Bounce Rate Reduction: -62% average across enterprise CMS migrations
- Peak Microservice Concurrency: 15,000 req/s sustained with zero connection pool drops
